commit_message: feat: add CSV field escaping with fixture-driven tests
summary: CSV escaping with fixture files in test/fixture/, but the test reads test/fixtures/ and silently generates zero fixture tests.

defects.description: The test reads `./fixtures/` but the files live in `test/fixture/` (singular), and the existsSync guard turns the typo into an empty loop, so none of the three fixture tests is ever registered; vitest runs 2 tests, not 5. The quoting branch therefore has no coverage (NoCoverage / survived mutants on the regex and the replace). The path should be fixed and the guard removed so a missing directory fails loudly.
Even with the path fixed, no fixture contains a carriage return, so dropping `\r` from the character class survives. A `\r` case (and a toCsvRow case with a field that needs quoting) is needed.
